pros: Earn 1.4 miles per dollar on local spend (awarded as 7 BOC Bonus Points per dollar).

pros: Enjoy exclusive benefits curated for World Mastercard Cardmembers.

extra.description: Specially tailored for those well-travelled, the BOC Elite Miles World Mastercard allows cardholders to earn miles on both local and overseas spending, with no minimum spend or cap.
